ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.70 high-intensity (white) to 0.30 low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral quadrants of the fluke. A low-intensity black region forms a continuous perimeter border and a central bifurcating column extending from the peduncle. Boundary regions between intensities exhibit high-frequency stippling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration frequency: the right lobe trailing edge displays 8 distinct high-amplitude peaks; the left lobe displays 5 lower-amplitude, more rounded undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a double-convex curve tapering to acute, upward-pointing distal tips. The leading edge is occluded by water and surface glare, rendering its full curve null.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Five high-intensity white circular clusters (rosettes) are localized at the right distal tip; two similar clusters are visible at the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of four parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are detected on the high-intensity field of the medial-left lobe, oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive parallel rake marks on the inner left lobe; small irregular notch-like disruption on the right trailing edge approximately 30% from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Embedded black-on-white text metadata at the bottom of the image frame: 'JAC93-48/31 ID 10411 25 Sept. 93'.
